title: Urgent Meeting: Austin Judicial Appointment
summary:
*   Austin leaders convened a special "emergency" meeting, primarily to address a single key item.
*   The meeting included a brief closed-door session for confidential deliberations, lasting about 15 minutes.
*   J. David Phillips was publicly appointed as an Associate Municipal Court Judge, filling an unexpired term.
transcript:
=CITY OF AUSTIN. TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Called Council Meeting
October 08, 1979
5:00 P.M.
First Floor Conference Room
Municipal Building
The meeting was called to order with Mayor McClellan presiding. Roll Call: Present: Mayor
McClellan, Mayor Pro Tern Himmelblau, Councilmembers
Cooke, Mullen, Snell, Goodman
Absent: Councilmember Trevino
Mayor McClellan opened the Emergency Special Called Council Meeting scheduled for 5:00
P.M., stating that this was a Meeting of the City Council for the purpose of publicly
announcing that it will convene in a closed or executive session authorized by Section 2,
Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated;
and after such closed or executive session any final action, decision or vote with regard
to any matter considered in the closed or executive session would be made in open session,
should such action, decision or vote be" necessary.
Mayor McClellan announced that the Council would go into executive session at this time to
consider the items authorized in Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated. MUNICIPAL JUDGE APPOINTMENT The Council
reconvened in open session at 5:15 P.M.
=CITY OF AUSTIN. TEXAS,
Motion
Councilmember Cooke moved that the Council appoint J.David Phillips as Associate Judge,
Municipal Court, for a term expiring January, 1980.
(Filling unexpired two year term of Judge Schreiber) The motion, seconded by Councilmember
Mullen, carried by the following vote: Ayes: Mayor McClellan, Mayor Pro Tern Himmelblau,
Councilmembers
Goodman, Mullen, Cooke, Snell
Noes: None
Absent: Councilmember Trevino
ADJOURNMENT
Council adjourned its meeting at 5:20 P.M. APPROVED
' Mayor
